title: Downright
summary: DOWNRIGHT, adverb 1. Right down; straight down; perpendicularly. A giant cleft downright 2. In plain terms; without ceremony or circumlocution. We shall chide downright 3. Completely; without stopping

inlines.v: DOWNRIGHT, adverb 1. Right down; straight down; perpendicularly. A giant cleft downright 2. In plain terms; without ceremony or circumlocution. We shall chide downright 3. Completely; without stopping short; as, she fell downright into a fit. DOWNRIGHT, adjective 1. Directly to the point; plain; open; artless; undisguised; as downright madness; downright nonsense; downright wisdom; downright falsehood; downright atheism. 2. Plain; artless; unceremonious; blunt; as, he spoke in his downright way.
